objective.title: Transfer and qualify exact binary64 and decimal formatting

declared.summary: Install both pinned owner-authorized AURA exact binary64 and decimal formatter sources; independently qualify exact binary values, floating-point boundaries and decimal precision; verify package tests and foundation regressions; complete C02 if every contract passes.
declared.value: Delivers a complete additional M1 math capability in one bounded run rather than spreading transfer, behavioral GREEN, boundary RED/GREEN and verification across several operator invocations.
debtChanges: The C02 T2 RED demonstrates missing boundary APIs before transfer; actual nonfinite/subnormal/signed-zero and precision acceptance is determined only by post-transfer tests.
Canonical rational values cannot preserve the negative IEEE-754 zero sign bit; Math explicitly treats both signed zero inputs as exact zero.
Decimal rounding mode semantics are tested for supported declared cases; no global magnitude/allocation budget or universal locale behavior is claimed.
declared.nextAction: Refine M1-W01-C03 dimensions/quantity/temperature source contracts and prepare a substantive qualified implementation run; leave C03 planned until source and test readiness are evidenced.
